mandatory_controller_behavior: Select the exact permitted FX3 using fresh cached topology before constructing any object that can open/reset/query it; do not use PMCA broad Sony listing.
Record enter intent before the first transfer; cleanup and state tracking must cover failures during either authentication and reenumeration.
Keep transport result, camera-event consumption, worker completion, return to ordinary interface, host driver reattachment and physical camera operation separate.
A return0 is not completion or queue-admission proof; an error does not mean the action was not already queued.
Do not automatically retry start/authentication/stop or reset when transport outcome or identity is uncertain.
Bound host waiting and preserve UNKNOWN on timeout; do not assert that a host deadline canceled camera work.
Do not swallow exit or reattach errors, and do not convert disposal or interface-release success into restoration success.
Driver capture/restoration must use a reviewed explicit pair and independently observe the same body's restored ordinary identity and driver.
Neither /setting/sen/smode nor /ramdsk/dev/mode is to be read, removed or modified under this session-only design.
unresolved_before_any_live_release: A host controller and exact Mac transport backend with pinned dependencies are not yet implemented or reviewed for a live session.
Actual driver access, complete dynamic binding, queue ownership/delivery and cancellation timing have not been measured on this body.
Per-transfer and whole-session time limits need explicit review; no tested numeric deadlines are asserted here.
Current cached identity, single-body selection, battery/recording/update state and media ownership must be verified before a future authorized operation.
A matching authorization for USB access, capture, both limited authentication sequences, normal history effects and exit/reattach is still absent.
